title: LEA framework profile
description: Report wording for one compliance framework. Rules join a framework through std:<id> and std:<id>:<control> tags; this profile only supplies the names and text LEA prints in evidence and stakeholder reports.

id.description: The <id> in std:<id> rule tags; also the file name.

short_label.description: Compact name for chips, cards and charts.

description.description: One sentence on which technical checks the report covers, e.g. "Selected automated technical checks associated with ...". Report cover subtitle and settings card text. Do not claim independent verification, certification, implementation or compliance.

legal_context.description: Why the standard matters legally or commercially; the callout of the GRC (Legal) report. Optional.

control_label.description: What the standard calls a requirement: Safeguard, Practice, Annex A control, Article. Used for mapped requirement IDs; generic std:<id> tags are reported as technical checks, never as requirements.

evidence_columns.description: Optional extra columns of the evidence report, in order. The check, mapped requirement, host, result, result observation time and run provenance columns are always printed and cannot be renamed. Default: Value, Record MAC, Agent.
